prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a finished wide GitHub README brand banner for SeichiGo, an anime pilgrimage map and AI itinerary planning website.
Create one original premium brand banner, landscape 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 1536 x 512. It should feel at home above a contemporary white website with cherry pink accents, dark ink typography and delicate Japanese travel imagery.
The exact only text is "SeichiGo" with exactly this capitalization. Make the wordmark large, clean, sharp, highly legible, and central, occupying most of the center width. Pair it with an original simple cherry-pink map pin / journey route symbol. Integrate a delicate illustrated Japanese streetscape and distant mountain silhouette toward the edges, with sparse cherry blossom accents and a fine pink itinerary line connecting a few circular points across the lower portion. Airy soft ivory/white background, restrained pale pink and cool lilac scenery, deep charcoal wordmark, polished editorial travel illustration, beautifully balanced negative space but no huge empty margins.
Must look like a complete full-width header artwork, NOT a tiny square logo floating in a blank canvas. No mascot, no chibi character, no old green/brown logo, no mockup, no rounded plastic plaque, no drop-shadow card, no extra slogan, no additional text, no UI controls, no red border, no watermark. Text area remains uncluttered. The same wordmark banner will be used on English, Chinese and Japanese README pages.
revision_prompt: Edit this SeichiGo banner only to fix its background/transparency. The finished artwork must be entirely opaque, with a bright harmonious sky across the entire top edge; no black or dark grey patch, no transparency, no vignette. Keep all lettering and layout unchanged.
